title: Occupancy Supplements, Age Discounts and Free Places by Vacation Package Product
content:
A package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products is priced for the party, and the supplement and the discounts a traveller attracts are read off the product booked. The figures are expressed as a share of the per-person price except where a flat amount is recorded.

## Supplements and discounts

| Product | Single supplement | Third adult sharing discount | Child charged as a child up to and including this age | Child discount | Infant travels at the infant price under this age | Infant price | Paying travellers that earn one free place |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 65 per cent | 10 per cent | 11 | 15 per cent | 2 | 99.00 USD | none, recorded as 0 |
| Flex Bundle Package | 55 per cent | 12 per cent | 11 | 20 per cent | 2 | 99.00 USD | none, recorded as 0 |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 50 per cent | 15 per cent | 12 | 35 per cent | 2 | 149.00 USD | none, recorded as 0 |
| Escorted Tour Package | 45 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 | 25 per cent | 2 | 149.00 USD | 20 |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 75 per cent | 8 per cent | 12 | 20 per cent | 2 | 199.00 USD | 16 |
| Luxury Collection Package | 40 per cent | 20 per cent | 12 | 30 per cent | 2 | 199.00 USD | none, recorded as 0 |

## Points of judgement on the age columns

A traveller aged exactly the child age recorded against the product is still charged as a child, the column being read up to and including that age; a traveller one year older is not. An infant is a traveller under the infant age recorded, so a traveller who has reached the age of 2 is no longer an infant on any product in the range.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A traveller aged 12 on the Value Bundle Package, whose child age is 11, is outside the child column; the same traveller on the All-Inclusive Resort Package, whose child age is 12, is inside it and attracts the 35 per cent child discount on a per-person price. A traveller occupying a cabin alone on the Ocean Cruise Package attracts a supplement of 75 per cent of the per-person price, the highest recorded in the range, while the same traveller on the Luxury Collection Package attracts 40 per cent.
